text:
emily: quick accessibility review request for the Models table row hover/focus transitions. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/4922 — noticed a couple of issues when running keyboard + VO.
raj: thanks. what did you see?
marta: reproducing: when tabbing into table rows the visual hover fades in with a transition and the focus ring is not visible during the transition. VO sometimes reads the entire row twice if the hover triggers a DOM reflow.
jon: looks like we animate background-color + transform on the row and also toggle a small badge group which re-renders. avoid animating layout-affecting properties; prefer opacity/transform-only patterns.
emily: good call. for focus persistence we need the ring to be independent of the animated layer. idea: put the focusable element (the row link) above the animated layer with a persistent outline via :focus-visible on the anchor.
raj: +1. also saw contrast regression on the 'Last run' timestamp when the row hover darkens the bg. small text dropped below 4.5:1 in light theme.
marta: quick CSS patch I tried locally:```css
.row {transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease;}
.row__bg {pointer-events: none;}
.row__link:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 3px;}
.row__meta {color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-700) 80%, black 20%);} /* boost contrast */
```
emily: can we avoid changing tokens? prefer computed mixes so themes stay consistent. also add prefers-reduced-motion handling.
jon: add a11y test plan: 1) keyboard tab into row -> focus ring persists during transition, 2) VoiceOver/NVDA read the row once, 3) timestamp contrast >=4.5:1 on both themes, 4) reduced-motion respects user setting.
aria-qa: I'll run VO/NVDA/JAWS across mac/win and test with zoom 125% and 200%. note: if you move badges in DOM order it can change screen reader linearization. keep the logical order stable and use CSS to reorganize visually if needed.
raj: tiny copy nit for SR: change timestamp aria-label from "3m" to "3 minutes ago" so it reads naturally. also for rows with status chips, use full phrases like "status: active" in the sr-only label to avoid ambiguity.
marta: will add sr-only elements with clear text and mark animated clones aria-hidden. i'll also add a Storybook story for keyboard walkthrough and a visual diff for the timestamp contrast.
emily: excellent. assign to marta, tag @aria-qa for verification and @jon for infra review. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
